criteria.name: identity_and_source_backed_footprint
criteria.rationale: Official Purdue GIS FID 411 / BALY identifies Ralph & Bettye Bailey Hall. The build script generates the structural shell from the projected source ring.

criteria.name: position_orientation_scale_dimensions
criteria.rationale: The shell matches the provided GIS polygon through the documented project-local transform. The polygon is not a survey, and the photos do not independently verify facade orientation or absolute position accuracy.

criteria.name: height_floors_roof
criteria.rationale: Two Purdue photos support two visible window rows, a flat parapet, and a higher entry tower. The 7.5 m parapet and 10.18 m tower heights remain estimates. GIS NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO both report five; the meanings and units of F02, R, and Extrution are undocumented, so R=33.4 does not establish a measured tower height.

criteria.name: facade_entrances_distinctive_architecture
criteria.rationale: The photos support the brick and stone palette, two window rows, raised entrance volume, tall glazing, sign panel, and shallow canopy. The model depicts the tower as a projecting full-height facade volume. Exact location, proportions, signage, and unseen facades remain schematic.

criteria.name: modular_export_portability_complete_evidence
criteria.rationale: A fresh Blender 5.2.3 reopen confirms the expected one-object collection, 2,968 vertices, 2,088 faces, and bounds z=0–10.18 m. GIS and photo snapshots, observations, build script, and fresh preview are present.

evidence.observation: Purdue GIS FID 411 identifies BALY and supplies the footprint, NUM_LEVELS=5, CountOfFLO=5, F02=16.7, R=33.4, and Extrution=28.
The metadata identifies US survey feet for the coordinate system but does not define units or meanings for F02, R, or Extrution.
The photos show two visible window rows, brick and stone details, a flat parapet, raised entrance tower, tall glazing, sign panel, and canopy. Neither supplies calibrated height or orientation.
Fresh Blender 5.2.3 reopen: expected object and collection, one collection object, 2,968 vertices, 2,088 faces, and z bounds 0–10.1803 m.
Preview shows the projected entrance tower, glazing, sign panel, cap, and canopy; it reads more clearly as an entrance volume than the prior revision.

findings: The model reaches the 8/10 threshold. Its height remains estimated; do not treat GIS R=33.4 as a measured height until its field meaning and units are verified.
The five-level GIS attributes remain unresolved against the two visible facade rows.
Oblique photos leave orientation, tower dimensions, exact entrance placement, and unseen facades approximate.
evaluator_implementation: The reviewer independently scored each rubric criterion against the source snapshots, build script, preview, and fresh Blender 5.2.3 reopen, then summed the criterion points.
